hard_failures.detail: No `quantifiers.ordered` list, no `quantifiers.formal` sentence, no `quantifiers.domains`. The content lives in `exact_quantifiers` as prose fields (`form`, `forall`, `quantifier_order`). R03 requires an ordered list of {kind in [forall,exists,exists_unique,not_exists], binder, domain, domain_id} with every domain_id resolving in `quantifiers.domains`.

No `topology.spacetime_dimension=4` (dimension is the prose '3+1'), no `topology.slice_topology`, no `topology.conformal_boundary` (I+, I-, i0 are separate prose keys), no `topology.forbidden`. R04 requires closed/periodic slices to be explicitly forbidden.

No `regularity` block separating data_regularity, solution_regularity, i_plus_regularity, extension_regularity, extension_solution_concept, and no non-empty `must_not_conflate`. The distinctions are present as prose (`metric_regularity`, `extension_class_notes`, `conventions.data_versus_extension_classes`), so this is a conformance failure, not a conceptual one.

Canonical keys absent (ambient_space, topology_or_measure, generic_set, excluded_set, transfer_failures, is_part_of_class, changing-notion statement). `kind` is a prose string that names both an open-dense reading and a residual/comeager reading, which are NOT equivalent: an open dense set is comeager but the converse fails (irrationals in [0,1] are comeager with empty interior). The file's own `reviewer_focus` asks whether the genericity field is usable as stated; it is not.

`conclusion_type: strong_cosmic_censorship` does not equal the vocabulary value required for this class, `scc_c2_future_inextendibility`; there is no `conclusion.conclusion_type`; `forbidden_strengthenings` is absent. NOTE: this is an identity/naming failure, not conclusion inflation. On the inflation axis the file is clean (see F-2).

R10: visibility.role is the string `not_used_in_conclusion`, not the vocabulary token `not_in_conclusion`; the SCC block must also state that the visible-singularity falsifier belongs to WCC. Content is present in prose (`role`, `completeness`, `why_absent_from_conclusion`).
